proposition.claim: When the proposed skill fails goal validation, the printed rule ranks state proximity over \(A(g)\cup\{z_h\}\), where \(A(g)\) contains goal-valid skills. The following prose says the rejected proposal \(z_h\) is only a fallback when no valid candidate exists.

repair.content: Make the rule conditional: retain \(z_h\) if it is valid; otherwise rank over \(A(g)\) when nonempty; use an explicitly chosen fallback only when \(A(g)=\varnothing\). Align the empty-set fallback with the implementation, which uses nearest goal proximity rather than necessarily returning \(z_h\).
